SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE ring only, standing upright on the top face, the wide lattice front facing the camera, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier's own product photograph of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on its design: copy its construction and its metal colour EXACTLY; it is the supplier's photo of the ring worn on a hand holding a bag strap: take ONLY the ring. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of it. IMAGE 2 is a close detail of the same piece. IMAGE 3 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A WIDE OPENWORK LATTICE RING: a broad gold tone band about 15mm wide at the front, made of an open DIAMOND LATTICE of fine gold wires, each wire finely beaded like a row of tiny grains, with a small round gold dot where the wires cross, and a softly scalloped edge on both sides. The skin shows through every opening. The band narrows toward the back of the finger. An open lattice, never a solid band, never woven mesh, never set with stones; gold tone only.

SCALE TEST: The lattice is about 15mm wide at the front, narrowing to about 5mm at the back. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
